purpose: Exploratory historical screening, not certification or live allocation
window_warning: Both historical windows overlap previously inspected LONA research. Neither is a fresh holdout. No hyperopt or parameter selection on these results.

reserved_forward_window.rule: Evaluate unchanged finalists only after this window completes; any parameter change requires a new protocol and untouched window. No live or recurring job is authorized by this reservation.

execution.cost_note: Assumed 5 bp taker fee plus 2 bp proportional friction, stress adds 5 bp. Friction is a fee proxy, not price-path slippage.
execution.funding_note: Use available native funding and mark data; explicitly permit zero fallback for missing rates. Missing historic funding blocks certification even if screening metrics pass.
execution.original_controls: Upstream entry/exit/risk defaults unchanged; common 2500 USDT proposed stake, wallet/cost/data/execution settings. Not risk-matched to derivatives.

session_rule: Entry fill clock: Monday-Friday, 08:00 <= London local time < 12:00 OR 08:00 <= New York local time < 12:00. IANA timezone DST; exits always allowed. Identical entry logic and risk to XAU unfiltered control.

deferred.freqai: Conditional next study after useful baseline evidence; not trained or claimed validated here
deferred.nfi_x8: Reference benchmark only; multi-pair 5m assumptions need separate study
deferred.orderflow: Requires verified raw-trade history and separate resources
deferred.15m_adaptation: Not silently substituted for upstream 5m/1h. Separate preregistered comparison if native-timeframe evidence warrants it.
